# TextAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Horizontal alignment of text within the width available to it.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Left`
- `Center`
- `Right`
- `Middle`
- `Justify`
- `Start`: Inline start: left in LTR, right in RTL.
- `End`: Inline end: right in LTR, left in RTL.
